_meta.title: Upscale video: NVIDIA RTX
_meta.description: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution through Comfy-Org/Nvidia_RTX_Nodes_ComfyUI (Apache-2.0 node pack). The nvidia-vfx SDK it calls is NVIDIA proprietary, needs an RTX GPU and driver >= 580.82, and is installed separately into the ComfyUI venv from https://pypi.nvidia.com. Deterministic, non-generative SR: sharper than bicubic, no invented detail. LoadVideo -> GetVideoComponents -> target size from the source size (the builder sets the scale expression: 2x stops at a 3840 long side, 1080p = short side 1080, 4K = long side 3840; never below 1x or above 4x; rounded to /8) -> frame cap -> RTXVideoSuperResolution (target dimensions, HIGHBITRATE_ULTRA) -> CreateVideo (source fps + audio) -> SaveVideo. Frame cap: the upscaled clip is held in RAM as a float tensor (a 4K frame is about 100 MB), so clips stop at 1990656000 pixel-frames (240 frames at 4K, 960 at 1080p) and at 4096 frames; CreateVideo trims the audio to the kept frames. No model files: the weights ship inside the SDK.
